name: port-nosignal
summary: Declare the HDMI input ports "no signal" after 200 x 20 ms = 4.0 s instead of 10 s (faster automatic input scan); DP and USB-C keep the vendor 8 s

edits.asm: sub_260E0E ori r5,r0,0x1f4 -> ori r5,r0,0xc8 (port +0x1A no-signal threshold, type bit3/4/0x400, normal case)

notes: Port +0x1A thresholds set by sub_260E0E (vendor: 400 passes for type 0x20 = ports 0 USB-C and 1 DP, 500 for types bit3/4/0x400 = ports 2-5, 200 in the flag case). v3: ports 2-5 -> 200; ports 0 (USB-C) and 1 (DP) unchanged and equal (v2 gave them different values: no standby with fixed DP). LG 28MQ780 uses 100. Accept thresholds (+0x18, see port-accept) unchanged. Generated by tools/patches_src_port_nosignal.py (NOSIG=n, 50-255).
